# Business model: Quiz Maker

- Owner: biz-business-model
- Language: en
- Status: hypothesis
- Date: 2026-11-10
- Offer: Quiz Maker; who pays: the teacher; who uses: the teacher; goal: 10 paying teachers in 12 weeks (state file, 2026-11-09)

## What stays free
- nothing recorded

## Revenue model
- Unit: per teacher per month, because the value grows with the teacher's own students [1]
- Billing: recurring per month; payment: not chosen
- Price: see docs/business/pricing.md (proposed)

| Payment fee | fee % | 3 | [1] |
| Support | hours | 5 per month | state file |
